SELECT id, storage_path, mime_type, attachment_type, source_attachment_id FROM t_feedback_attachment WHERE security_status = 'QUARANTINED' AND upload_status = 'VERIFIED' AND integrity_status = 'VERIFIED' AND decryption_status IN ('NOT_REQUIRED', 'DECRYPTED') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND storage_path IS NOT NULL AND (security_next_retry_at IS NULL OR security_next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET malware_scan_status='CLEAN', content_review_status='PASS', storage_path=#{path}, storage_key_id=#{keyId}, security_status='VERIFIED', security_processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), security_next_retry_at=NULL, log_preview_ciphertext=#{logPreviewCiphertext}, log_preview_key_id=CASE WHEN #{logPreviewCiphertext} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE #{keyId} END, log_preview_plaintext_bytes=#{logPreviewPlaintextBytes}, log_preview_status=CASE WHEN attachment_type<>'LOG' THEN NULL WHEN #{logPreviewCiphertext} IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END, log_preview_error_code=NULL, media_preview_status=CASE WHEN attachment_type IN ('IMAGE','SCREENSHOT','ANNOTATED_SCREENSHOT','VIDEO','SCREEN_RECORDING') THEN 'PENDING' ELSE NULL END, media_preview_priority=CASE WHEN attachment_type IN ('IMAGE','SCREENSHOT','ANNOTATED_SCREENSHOT','VIDEO','SCREEN_RECORDING') THEN 100 ELSE 0 END, media_preview_next_retry_at=CASE WHEN attachment_type IN ('IMAGE','SCREENSHOT','ANNOTATED_SCREENSHOT','VIDEO','SCREEN_RECORDING') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, media_preview_error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND security_status='QUARANTINED'

mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET log_preview_ciphertext=#{ciphertext}, log_preview_key_id=#{keyId}, log_preview_plaintext_bytes=#{plaintextBytes}, log_preview_status='AVAILABLE', log_preview_error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND attachment_type='LOG' AND security_status='VERIFIED' AND (log_preview_status IS NULL OR log_preview_status='PENDING')

UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET log_preview_status='FAILED', log_preview_error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id} AND attachment_type='LOG' AND (log_preview_status IS NULL OR log_preview_status='PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, attachment_type, mime_type, file_size_bytes, media_preview_attempts AS attempts FROM t_feedback_attachment WHERE attachment_type IN ('IMAGE','SCREENSHOT','ANNOTATED_SCREENSHOT','VIDEO','SCREEN_RECORDING') AND security_status='VERIFIED' AND integrity_status='VERIFIED' AND decryption_status IN ('NOT_REQUIRED','DECRYPTED') AND malware_scan_status='CLEAN' AND content_review_status='PASS' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND media_preview_attempts < 3 AND (#{ffmpegEnabled}=TRUE OR (attachment_type NOT IN ('VIDEO','SCREEN_RECORDING') AND COALESCE(mime_type,'')<>'image/webp')) AND ((media_preview_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND (media_preview_next_retry_at IS NULL OR media_preview_next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR (media_preview_status='PROCESSING' AND media_preview_next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY media_preview_priority DESC, media_preview_next_retry_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET media_preview_status='PROCESSING', media_preview_attempts=media_preview_attempts+1, media_preview_next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), media_preview_lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}, media_preview_error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND media_preview_attempts < 3 AND ((media_preview_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND (media_preview_next_retry_at IS NULL OR media_preview_next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR (media_preview_status='PROCESSING' AND media_preview_next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))

UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET media_preview_status='AVAILABLE', media_preview_object_key=#{objectKey}, media_preview_object_version=#{objectVersion}, media_preview_object_etag=#{objectEtag}, media_preview_bytes=#{contentLength}, media_preview_width=#{width}, media_preview_height=#{height}, media_preview_next_retry_at=NULL, media_preview_lease_owner=NULL, media_preview_error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND media_preview_status='PROCESSING' AND media_preview_lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND security_status='VERIFIED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET media_preview_status='FAILED', media_preview_error_code=#{errorCode}, media_preview_next_retry_at=CASE WHEN media_preview_attempts < 3 THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL POW(4, media_preview_attempts) MINUTE) ELSE NULL END, media_preview_lease_owner=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND media_preview_status='PROCESSING' AND media_preview_lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}
mapper.select: SELECT id, media_preview_object_key AS object_key, media_preview_object_version AS object_version, media_preview_object_etag AS object_etag, media_preview_bytes AS content_length, media_preview_width AS width, media_preview_height AS height, media_preview_status AS status FROM t_feedback_attachment WHERE id=#{id} AND media_preview_status='AVAILABLE'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET malware_scan_status = 'CLEAN', content_review_status = 'REVIEW_NEEDED', security_status = 'REJECTED', upload_status = 'FAILED', security_last_error_code = 'ATTACHMENT_CONTENT_REVIEW_UNSUPPORTED', security_processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), security_next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND security_status = 'QUARANTINED'

UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET malware_scan_status = 'CLEAN', content_review_status = 'REJECTED', security_status = 'REJECTED', upload_status = 'FAILED', security_processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), security_next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND security_status = 'QUARANTINED'

UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET malware_scan_status = 'INFECTED', content_review_status = 'REJECTED', security_status = 'REJECTED', upload_status = 'FAILED', security_processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), security_next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND security_status = 'QUARANTINED'

UPDATE t_feedback_attachment SET malware_scan_status = 'ERROR', security_retry_count = security_retry_count + 1, security_last_error_code = #{code}, security_next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND security_status = 'QUARANTINED'
